name: TrailingTakeProfit
summary: This EA is a trailing take-profit utility that dynamically adjusts the take-profit level of existing open positions as price moves in the favorable direction. It does not open trades on its own but manages profit targets to lock in gains while allowing positions to capture more profit. Users configure the trailing distance and step parameters to control how aggressively the take-profit follows price movement.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个追踪止盈工具，当价格朝有利方向移动时，动态调整现有持仓的止盈水平。它不会自行开仓，而是通过管理盈利目标来锁定收益，同时允许仓位捕获更多利润。用户可以配置追踪距离和步长参数来控制止盈跟随价格运动的激进程度。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于仓位管理工具而非自主交易策略。其核心概念是在持仓浮盈增加时，逐步将止盈价位向有利方向移动，从而在保留盈利空间的同时锁定已有利润。入场条件方面，该EA不主动入场，而是依赖于已有持仓的存在。出场条件由被调整的止盈水平触发，当价格回撤至当前止盈位时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有订单的止盈参数。资金管理方面，该EA通过追踪止盈间接保护资金，但本身不执行风险控制逻辑如止损设置或仓位比例计算。用户需自行确保已有仓位设置了合理的止损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA functions as a position management tool rather than an autonomous trading strategy. Its core concept is to progressively move the take-profit level in the favorable direction as unrealized profit increases, thereby locking in gains while preserving room for further profit. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not initiate trades; it depends entirely on pre-existing open positions to manage. Exit conditions are triggered when price retraces to the current trailing take-profit level, at which point the position is closed by the broker. For position sizing, the EA does not calculate or modify lot sizes, only adjusting the take-profit parameter of existing orders. In terms of money management, the EA indirectly protects capital by trailing take-profit, but it does not implement risk control logic such as stop-loss placement or position sizing ratios. Users must ensure that existing positions have reasonable stop-losses configured independently.

parameters.name: TrailingDistance
parameters.description: 追踪止盈与当前价格的距离（点数）
parameters.description_en: Trailing take-profit distance from price in points

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 每次调整止盈的最小步长（点数）
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop step; minimum points for each stop adjustment

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定管理的订单魔术号，0为管理所有订单

parameters.name: ApplyToSymbol
parameters.description: 应用的交易品种，current为当前图表品种

parameters.name: ActivationLevel
parameters.description: 激活追踪止盈的最低盈利点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Minimum profit points threshold to activate trailing take-profit

pros: 自动化管理止盈水平，减少交易者手动操作的需求
灵活的参数配置，适应不同交易风格和市场环境
可与任何自主开仓策略组合使用，增强整体交易系统的盈利保护能力
pros_en: Automates take-profit management, reducing the need for manual intervention by the trader
Flexible parameter configuration adapts to different trading styles and market conditions
Can be combined with any independent trade-opening strategy to enhance profit protection of the overall trading system
cons: 不主动开仓也不设置止损，依赖用户自行管理入场和风险控制
追踪步长设置不当可能导致过早止盈或止盈追踪不及时
在剧烈波动市场中，止盈可能频繁被触发后价格继续朝原方向运行，造成机会成本损失
cons_en: Does not open positions or set stop-losses, relying entirely on the user to manage entries and risk control
Improper trailing step settings may cause premature take-profit triggering or delayed trailing adjustments
In highly volatile markets, the take-profit may be frequently triggered right before price continues in the original direction, resulting in opportunity cost losses
improvements: 增加止损追踪功能，实现止盈与止损的协同管理
添加盈利回撤百分比模式作为追踪止盈的替代策略，提高灵活性
improvements_en: Add stop-loss trailing functionality to enable coordinated management of both take-profit and stop-loss
Implement a profit-drawdown percentage mode as an alternative trailing strategy to increase flexibility

risk_points: 该EA不执行交易操作，仅修改已有订单的止盈参数，风险极低
若用户误以为该EA包含止损保护而未手动设置止损，可能在极端行情中遭受超出预期的损失
risk_points_en: The EA does not execute trade operations, only modifies take-profit parameters of existing orders, presenting minimal risk
If users mistakenly assume the EA includes stop-loss protection and fail to set stop-losses manually, they may incur larger-than-expected losses during extreme market conditions
